text: The enrollment button is rendered inside a `<form … method="post">` so the browser will submit a POST request when the user clicks “Enroll now” [1]. In the API view that processes the request, only a `post()` method is defined and no other HTTP verbs are allowed [3]. Because enrolling adds the user to the course’s `students` many‑to‑many relationship, it changes server state and therefore must be sent as a POST, not a GET which is intended only for safe retrieval [2]. Using POST triggers the view’s `post()` handler that executes `course.students.add(request.user)` and returns the enrollment response.
